change.task: RLY-2207 spike: prototype the RS256 verifier ADR-020 left open

events.what: jwt-oidc-verify 1.0.0 published on the public index (attacker)
priya.n starts a coding session for RLY-2207; GitHub App installation token issued (one hour)
session's Relay agent token renewed (15 minutes)
agent runs pip install jwt-oidc-verify; pip builds the source distribution and runs its setup script
setup script posts the session's environment to api.github.com
attacker clones the private repository with the App token
stolen Relay agent token expires, never used
agent opens draft PR #2417 with the package in deploy/requirements.txt
attacker's push to .github/workflows/ refused (no workflows permission)
sam.o, reviewing #2417, finds the package is six weeks old, sdist only, with no source repository
aisha.r declares a P1 security incident
